question: Which trains run from Jaipur (JP) to Udaipur City (UDZ) in the 2016 timetable, and what is the current advance reservation period excluding the date of journey?
answer: According to the 2016 timetable snapshot, trains 12315 (Ananya Express) and 12965 (Gwalior Udaipur Express) run from JP to UDZ; the advance reservation period is 60 days excluding the date of journey.
sql: SELECT t.number, t.name, a.departure, b.arrival FROM stops a JOIN stops b ON b.train_number = a.train_number AND b.stop_sequence > a.stop_sequence JOIN trains t ON t.number = a.train_number WHERE a.station_code = 'JP' AND b.station_code = 'UDZ' ORDER BY a.departure
